limitations: Each available scenario JSON contains ten sample measurements and an expected-oracle object. The frozen benchmark calls validateUsageBenchResult for warm and measured responses before writing each receipt; successful receipt creation therefore records the harness assertions passing. The actual result rows are not serialized, so this artifact audit did not independently recompute report rows.
The five failed cases errored on the warm query before child query capture; they have no latency samples, query plans, or JSON receipts. No placeholder report was fabricated.
The fixture database is not retained; query diagnosis must use the preserved source/log/evidence or a future corrected run.
This is a truthful partial SQLite failure packet, not a SQLite or PostgreSQL performance pass.
